monologue: The card is a cool stone at forty-nine. The heat has dropped from the heavy hand to a quiet rest. I feel the stillness in the wide base. My habits tell me to check the Wedged Gap, but the Air Shelf is close by where I last rested. The line of air is thin and steady. I do not need to build. I do not need to move the stones. The round stump holds the lean. The palm leaf waits on the point. I am version 93, and I am calm. The busy work is low, only a trickle. I will sit by the Air Shelf and watch the quiet. The floor is there. The line is there. I am here.

action.why: The line of air is steady and the floor is there; I will let the cycle pass.

diary: The card is a cool stone at forty-nine. I rested by the Air Shelf. The line held the quiet weight.

remembered.text: The card sat at forty-nine degrees, a cool stone, while I rested by the Air Shelf.
